name: OGX
recent: OGX 于 2026 年 10 月 28 日召开第二次常年股东大会及特别股东大会，股东批准以 1900 万令吉收购莎阿南 Bukit Jelutong 的仓库物业。公司于 2026 年 9 月宣布通过 HYXI 分销权进军可再生能源领域，瞄准数据中心市场。最新季度（2026 年 8 月 31 日止）营收 8551 万令吉，净利 716 万令吉，环比分别增长 46.7% 和 90.3%。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会批准以 1900 万令吉现金收购莎阿南 Bukit Jelutong 的仓库物业。
公司宣布通过 HYXI 分销权进军可再生能源领域，瞄准数据中心市场。
2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度营收 8551 万令吉，净利 716 万令吉，环比分别增长 46.7% 和 90.3%。
earnings: 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度营收 8551 万令吉，净利 716 万令吉，净利率 8.4%；营收环比增长 46.7%，净利环比增长 90.3%，净利率由 6.5% 提升至 8.4%。

recent_en: OGX held its 2nd AGM and EGM on 28 October 2026, where shareholders approved the RM19 million acquisition of a warehouse in Bukit Jelutong, Shah Alam. In September 2026, the company announced its entry into the renewable energy sector via an HYXI distributorship, targeting the data centre market. For the latest quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM85.51 million and net profit RM7.16 million, up 46.7% and 90.3% QoQ respectively.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the RM19 million cash acquisition of a warehouse in Bukit Jelutong, Shah Alam at the EGM.
The company announced its entry into renewable energy through an HYXI distributorship, targeting the data centre market.
For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM85.51 million and net profit RM7.16 million, up 46.7% and 90.3% QoQ respectively.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM85.51 million and net profit RM7.16 million, with a net margin of 8.4%; revenue grew 46.7% QoQ and net profit 90.3% QoQ, with net margin rising from 6.5% to 8.4%.
